title: 2D Channel Laminar Poiseuille Flow (SU2)
description: Incompressible laminar Navier-Stokes SU2 configuration and companion 2D structured quad mesh for pressure-driven Poiseuille channel flow.
code:
% 2D Laminar Channel Poiseuille Flow (Re = 100)
PHYSICAL_PROBLEM= NAVIER_STOKES
MATH_PROBLEM= DIRECT
KIND_TURB_MODEL= NONE
MACH_NUMBER= 0.05
REYNOLDS_NUMBER= 100.0
FREESTREAM_DENSITY= 1.225
FREESTREAM_VELOCITY= ( 1.5, 0.0, 0.0 )
REF_AREA= 0.1
REF_LENGTH= 0.1
CFL_NUMBER= 2.0
MESH_FILENAME= channel.su2
MARKER_INLET= ( inlet, 288.15, 101350.0, 1.0, 0.0, 0.0 )
MARKER_OUTLET= ( outlet, 101325.0 )
MARKER_HEATFLUX= ( lower_wall, 0.0, upper_wall, 0.0 )

title: NACA 0012 Subsonic Inviscid Euler Airfoil

PHYSICAL_PROBLEM= EULER
MATH_PROBLEM= DIRECT
KIND_TURB_MODEL= NONE
MACH_NUMBER= 0.30
AOA= 2.5
REYNOLDS_NUMBER= 1.0e6
FREESTREAM_DENSITY= 1.225
FREESTREAM_VELOCITY= ( 102.0, 4.45, 0.0 )
REF_AREA= 1.0
REF_LENGTH= 1.0
CFL_NUMBER= 4.0
MESH_FILENAME= naca0012.su2

REYNOLDS_NUMBER= 6.5e6

REF_LENGTH= 1.0

title: Converging-Diverging Supersonic Rocket Nozzle Flow
description: Compressible de Laval converging-diverging rocket nozzle SU2 configuration and companion 2D nozzle mesh resolving choked throat and Mach 2.4 supersonic expansion.

PHYSICAL_PROBLEM= NAVIER_STOKES
SOLVER= RANS
MATH_PROBLEM= DIRECT
KIND_TURB_MODEL= SST
MACH_NUMBER= 2.4
REYNOLDS_NUMBER= 4.2e6
FREESTREAM_DENSITY= 0.85
FREESTREAM_VELOCITY= ( 820.0, 0.0, 0.0 )
REF_AREA= 0.05
REF_LENGTH= 0.25
CFL_NUMBER= 1.5
WALL_YPLUS= 1.0
MESH_FILENAME= nozzle_mesh.su2
MARKER_INLET= ( chamber_inlet, 3200.0, 4500000.0, 1.0, 0.0, 0.0 )
MARKER_OUTLET= ( exit_plane, 101325.0 )
